task: You are hungry! Let's cook a delicious meal. Check the cookbook in the kitchen for the recipe. Once done, enjoy your meal!
description:
You're now in the kitchen.

You see an opened conventional looking fridge right there by you. Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this? You can see an opened oven in the corner. The oven is empty! What a waste of a day! You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a table. On the table you can make out a cookbook. You see a counter. On the counter you make out a chopped red hot pepper, a raw red potato, a yellow bell pepper and a raw purple potato. Huh, weird. You can make out a stove. Why don't you take a picture of it, it'll last longer! But the thing hasn't got anything on it. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the stove.

thought: I should examine the cookbook on the table to find a recipe for a delicious meal.
feedback:
You open the copy of "Cooking: A Modern Approach (3rd Ed.)" and start reading:

Recipe #1
---------
Gather all following ingredients and follow the directions to prepare this tasty meal.

Ingredients:
red hot pepper

Directions:
chop the red hot pepper
  prepare meal
